name: Gideon's memorial
description: A memorial on Theros to Kytheon Iora, known as Gideon Jura, a founding member of the Gatewatch who died saving Liliana Vess from Nicol Bolas.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself against Nicol Bolas to save Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: he sacrificed himself to save Liliana Vess
